name: Goregrinders
blurb: Brutal, ferocious necro-warriors and speed freaks who pay tithe to the Corpse Piler, a colossal devil squatting over the machine forges. They fuse their flesh with black-metal blades, devil-blood injectors and infernal engines — wielding unbelievable power while always teetering on the brink of igniting in their own blaze.

specialMechanic.name: Blood Rage
specialMechanic.text: If a unit with this trait is reduced to 0 HP, it is not slain but gains 1 strength and remains at 0 HP. If it takes any further damage at 0 HP, it is slain as normal.

specialTags.Berserk: After a berserk unit ACTs, it splashes (self) 1 damage, then discards a berserk token. If it damages no other character, it deals 1 to itself ignoring armor. Counts as both positive and negative.
specialTags.Retaliation: After any ability that damages this unit resolves, this unit deals 1 damage back to the ability's owner, even if slain.
specialTags.Curseproof: Immune to damage and effects from enemy curses.
